units.rawText: The ground beneath my feet groans and cracks open.
units.displayText: The ground beneath my feet groans and cracks open.

spans.text: The ground beneath my feet groans and cracks open.

units.rawText: The stench of gore and char blend together to form that uniquely nauseating odor of the battlefield.
units.displayText: The stench of gore and char blend together to form that uniquely nauseating odor of the battlefield.

spans.text: The stench of gore and char blend together to form that uniquely nauseating odor of the battlefield.

units.rawText: We march through endless ruins, assaulting the Entropics before us over and over again.
units.displayText: We march through endless ruins, assaulting the Entropics before us over and over again.

spans.text: We march through endless ruins, assaulting the Entropics before us over and over again.

units.rawText: B Team, head off the Entropics coming from 1 o'clock! E Team, operate the defense node and intercept them!
units.displayText: B Team, head off the Entropics coming from 1 o'clock! E Team, operate the defense node and intercept them!

spans.text: B Team, head off the Entropics coming from 1 o'clock! E Team, operate the defense node and intercept them!

units.rawText: Whew...
units.displayText: Whew...

spans.text: Whew...

units.rawText: I recall a combat trick from a previous world line and condense operands into an attack, which I hurl at the Entropic hordes.
units.displayText: I recall a combat trick from a previous world line and condense operands into an attack, which I hurl at the Entropic hordes.

spans.text: I recall a combat trick from a previous world line and condense operands into an attack, which I hurl at the Entropic hordes.

units.rawText: It accurately and keenly pierces an Entropic's vitals, and purple slime sprays into the air amidst the creature's screams.
units.displayText: It accurately and keenly pierces an Entropic's vitals, and purple slime sprays into the air amidst the creature's screams.

spans.text: It accurately and keenly pierces an Entropic's vitals, and purple slime sprays into the air amidst the creature's screams.

units.rawText: I do this over and over again, until there are no more Entropics in sight.
units.displayText: I do this over and over again, until there are no more Entropics in sight.

spans.text: I do this over and over again, until there are no more Entropics in sight.

units.rawText: Comrade, I've defeated all the monsters on this side!
units.displayText: Comrade, I've defeated all the monsters on this side!

spans.text: Comrade, I've defeated all the monsters on this side!

units.rawText: Considering the speed at which he shapes operands and his combat skills... Mr. Okabe clearly has a gift for battle.
units.displayText: Considering the speed at which he shapes operands and his combat skills... Mr. Okabe clearly has a gift for battle.

spans.text: Considering the speed at which he shapes operands and his combat skills... Mr. Okabe clearly has a gift for battle.

units.rawText: Has my true power shocked you, Catgirl No. 2?!
units.displayText: Has my true power shocked you, Catgirl No. 2?!

spans.text: Has my true power shocked you, Catgirl No. 2?!

units.rawText: Well done, Okabe. Still, don't be too anxious to push forward.
units.displayText: Well done, Okabe. Still, don't be too anxious to push forward.

spans.text: Well done, Okabe. Still, don't be too anxious to push forward.

units.rawText: Kuku, well, if you say so, then I shall quell my bloodlust for now.
units.displayText: Kuku, well, if you say so, then I shall quell my bloodlust for now.

spans.text: Kuku, well, if you say so, then I shall quell my bloodlust for now.

units.rawText: Though I'm speaking in a casual tone, I know very well that this is just my way of suppressing my uneasiness.
units.displayText: Though I'm speaking in a casual tone, I know very well that this is just my way of suppressing my uneasiness.

spans.text: Though I'm speaking in a casual tone, I know very well that this is just my way of suppressing my uneasiness.

units.rawText: For some reason, a premonition of dread is slowly rising in my heart.
units.displayText: For some reason, a premonition of dread is slowly rising in my heart.

spans.text: For some reason, a premonition of dread is slowly rising in my heart.

units.rawText: Okabe! Focus!
units.displayText: Okabe! Focus!

spans.text: Okabe! Focus!

units.rawText: Uwah!
units.displayText: Uwah!

spans.text: Uwah!

units.rawText: An Entropic has broken through the defense line at some point. I reflexively reach out to fend it off, but it seems to only want to make contact with my hand and the Professor soon takes it down.
units.displayText: An Entropic has broken through the defense line at some point. I reflexively reach out to fend it off, but it seems to only want to make contact with my hand and the Professor soon takes it down.

spans.text: An Entropic has broken through the defense line at some point. I reflexively reach out to fend it off, but it seems to only want to make contact with my hand and the Professor soon takes it down.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Hsss...</color>
units.displayText: Hsss...

spans.text: Hsss...

units.rawText: The dying Entropic twitches, seemingly still trying to crawl towards me, but it soon stops moving.
units.displayText: The dying Entropic twitches, seemingly still trying to crawl towards me, but it soon stops moving.

spans.text: The dying Entropic twitches, seemingly still trying to crawl towards me, but it soon stops moving.

units.rawText: Are you alright?
units.displayText: Are you alright?

spans.text: Are you alright?

units.rawText: I'm fine.
units.displayText: I'm fine.

spans.text: I'm fine.

units.rawText: The Entropic seemed to be trying to pass a message. Was it a hint? Or... was it simply trying to say hi?
units.displayText: The Entropic seemed to be trying to pass a message. Was it a hint? Or... was it simply trying to say hi?

spans.text: The Entropic seemed to be trying to pass a message. Was it a hint? Or... was it simply trying to say hi?

units.rawText: ...Now where did that weird feeling come from?
units.displayText: ...Now where did that weird feeling come from?

spans.text: ...Now where did that weird feeling come from?

units.rawText: The Entropic horde is active again! I'm picking up a high operand energy reaction!
units.displayText: The Entropic horde is active again! I'm picking up a high operand energy reaction!

spans.text: The Entropic horde is active again! I'm picking up a high operand energy reaction!

units.rawText: ...The reaction's gone! Everyone, look out!
units.displayText: ...The reaction's gone! Everyone, look out!

spans.text: ...The reaction's gone! Everyone, look out!

units.rawText: Is their leader about to reveal itself...
units.displayText: Is their leader about to reveal itself...

spans.text: Is their leader about to reveal itself...

units.rawText: ...No, that's not right.
units.displayText: ...No, that's not right.

spans.text: ...No, that's not right.

units.rawText: A conjecture has been coiled around my heart all this time, and my uneasiness forces me to speak it—
units.displayText: A conjecture has been coiled around my heart all this time, and my uneasiness forces me to speak it—

spans.text: A conjecture has been coiled around my heart all this time, and my uneasiness forces me to speak it—

units.rawText: Their leader has always been here.
units.displayText: Their leader has always been here.

spans.text: Their leader has always been here.

units.rawText: Mr. Okabe... I don't get your meaning...
units.displayText: Mr. Okabe... I don't get your meaning...

spans.text: Mr. Okabe... I don't get your meaning...

units.rawText: I try my best to translate my thoughts into words.
units.displayText: I try my best to translate my thoughts into words.

spans.text: I try my best to translate my thoughts into words.

units.rawText: This battle... it's been going too well.
units.displayText: This battle... it's been going too well.

spans.text: This battle... it's been going
too
well.

units.rawText: Both the enemies in front of us and the Entropics in the defense line we just breached were nowhere as vicious as the Entropics in previous world lines...
units.displayText: Both the enemies in front of us and the Entropics in the defense line we just breached were nowhere as vicious as the Entropics in previous world lines...

spans.text: Both the enemies in front of us and the Entropics in the defense line we just breached were nowhere as vicious as the Entropics in previous world lines...

units.rawText: Right now, it seems as though...
units.displayText: Right now, it seems as though...

spans.text: Right now, it seems as though...

units.rawText: A familiar form flashes through my mind.
units.displayText: A familiar form flashes through my mind.

spans.text: A familiar form flashes through my mind.

units.rawText: <color=red>...As though they were playing with us.</color>
units.displayText: ...As though they were playing with us.

spans.text: ...As though they were playing with us.

units.rawText: The pounding of my heart drowns out the sound of the surrounding gunfire.
units.displayText: The pounding of my heart drowns out the sound of the surrounding gunfire.

spans.text: The pounding of my heart drowns out the sound of the surrounding gunfire.

units.rawText: The moment that thought sprang into my head, a cold terror immediately raced through my body.
units.displayText: The moment that thought sprang into my head, a cold terror immediately raced through my body.

spans.text: The moment that thought sprang into my head, a cold terror immediately raced through my body.

units.rawText: No, it can't be. It must be some sort of coincidence. I must be imagining things.
units.displayText: No, it can't be. It must be some sort of coincidence. I must be imagining things.

spans.text: No, it can't be. It must be some sort of coincidence. I must be imagining things.

units.rawText: But despite my best efforts to convince myself otherwise, I find myself looking behind and off to the side—
units.displayText: But despite my best efforts to convince myself otherwise, I find myself looking behind and off to the side—

spans.text: But despite my best efforts to convince myself otherwise, I find myself looking behind and off to the side—

units.rawText: —Where someone was always standing.
units.displayText: —Where someone was always standing.

spans.text: —Where someone was always standing.

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: The wind blows, blowing a blue hat through the air and depositing it at my feet.
units.displayText: The wind blows, blowing a blue hat through the air and depositing it at my feet.

spans.text: The wind blows, blowing a blue hat through the air and depositing it at my feet.

units.rawText: Ehehe~ You found me in the end, Okarin.
units.displayText: Ehehe~ You found me in the end, Okarin.

spans.text: Ehehe~ You found me in the end, Okarin.

units.rawText: That familiar, gentle voice cuts through the clamor of the battlefield and speaks into my ear.
units.displayText: That familiar, gentle voice cuts through the clamor of the battlefield and speaks into my ear.

spans.text: That familiar, gentle voice cuts through the clamor of the battlefield and speaks into my ear.

units.rawText: <size=60>Rumble!!</size>
units.displayText: Rumble!!

spans.text: Rumble!!

units.rawText: There is a massive tremor, as though it was trying to shake the entire battlefield to bits. Purple light shines down from the heavens, cutting through my attempts at self-obfuscation and laying bare the truth I'd been trying to avoid before me.
units.displayText: There is a massive tremor, as though it was trying to shake the entire battlefield to bits. Purple light shines down from the heavens, cutting through my attempts at self-obfuscation and laying bare the truth I'd been trying to avoid before me.

spans.text: There is a massive tremor, as though it was trying to shake the entire battlefield to bits. Purple light shines down from the heavens, cutting through my attempts at self-obfuscation and laying bare the truth I'd been trying to avoid before me.

units.rawText: Okabe!!
units.displayText: Okabe!!

spans.text: Okabe!!

units.rawText: Ah, you were the one from back then... Ehehe~ Thanks for telling Mayushii, Okarin really was in the Oasis after all.
units.displayText: Ah, you were the one from back then... Ehehe~ Thanks for telling Mayushii, Okarin really was in the Oasis after all.

spans.text: Ah, you were the one from back then... Ehehe~ Thanks for telling Mayushii, Okarin really was in the Oasis after all.

units.rawText: There were a few setbacks along the way and they hurt Mayushii very much... but Mayushii is Okarin's hostage, after all, so Mayushii can't just run off.
units.displayText: There were a few setbacks along the way and they hurt Mayushii very much... but Mayushii is Okarin's hostage, after all, so Mayushii can't just run off.

spans.text: There were a few setbacks along the way and they hurt Mayushii very much... but Mayushii is Okarin's hostage, after all, so Mayushii can't just run off.

units.rawText: And that's why Mayushii held on and came back.
units.displayText: And that's why Mayushii held on and came back.

spans.text: And that's why Mayushii held on and came back.

units.rawText: As the light fades, a figure slowly descends. She holds up her hand to the sky, as though she were shaking hands with the stars.
units.displayText: As the light fades, a figure slowly descends. She holds up her hand to the sky, as though she were shaking hands with the stars.

spans.text: As the light fades, a figure slowly descends. She holds up her hand to the sky, as though she were shaking hands with the stars.

units.rawText: I once thought she would climb a ladder to heaven. Now, she has ridden a beam of light back down to earth.
units.displayText: I once thought she would climb a ladder to heaven. Now, she has ridden a beam of light back down to earth.

spans.text: I once thought she would climb a ladder to heaven. Now, she has ridden a beam of light back down to earth.

units.rawText: Mayuri...
units.displayText: Mayuri...

spans.text: Mayuri...

units.rawText: That familiar figure puts her hand down and smiles gently at me.
units.displayText: That familiar figure puts her hand down and smiles gently at me.

spans.text: That familiar figure puts her hand down and smiles gently at me.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Tutturu~ ♪ At last, I found you again, Okarin~</color>
units.displayText: Tutturu~ ♪ At last, I found you again, Okarin~

spans.text: Tutturu~ ♪ At last, I found you again, Okarin~
